title: Six New Again 06+08
edition: 2026–27 Winter direct-mail reissue of Six issues 6 and 8 (digest edition)

description.main: The fourth volume of Six New Again, the 2026 Comme des Garçons direct-mail reissue of Six, pairing issues 6 and 8 of the 1988–91 magazine.
description.extended:
The fourth volume of Six New Again, the 2026 Comme des Garçons direct-mail revival of Six, pairing Issue 6 (1990) with Issue 8, the last of the original run.

Issue 6 is on the front cover, which reproduces John L. Murphy's Taxi Dancer (1964): a child's photographed face set into a painted figure. The back cover is Issue 8, and the reissue has so far skipped Issue 7. The volume runs to about 54 pages at 30 × 22 cm, against the original 40 × 30 cm, and went to customers for the Winter 2026–27 season. Photographs by Brian Griffin, Shoji Ueda, Peter Lindbergh, Servie Janssen, and Kanade Hamamoto fill the rest.

Six, short for the sixth sense, ran to eight issues between 1988 and 1991. Rei Kawakubo filled it with photography, art, design, and text, and the label gave it away instead of selling it. The 2026 reissue runs as four volumes. The library holds all four: 01–02, 03–04, 05, and 06+08. This is the fourth.

notes: Comme des Garçons 2026–27 Winter direct mail. Issue 6 on the front cover, Issue 8 on the back. Issue 7 not reissued as of November 2026. Cover photograph: John L. Murphy, Taxi Dancer, 1964 (credit printed on the cover). The original Six (1988–1991, eight issues, art direction Tsuguya Inoue) measured 40 × 30 cm. Page count is the dealer's approximate figure (page-spread lists conflicting counts across its listings).
